summary: Modine Manufacturing filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a press release that it will rename itself Modexus Solutions following the spinoff of its Performance Technologies business and its merger with Gentherm. Gentherm shareholders overwhelmingly approved the transaction at a special meeting that day, with closing now expected October 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions and Modine shareholder approval of the charter amendment effecting the name change. Post-close, Modexus will trade on the NYSE under MOD, led by CEO Neil Brinker and CFO Mick Lucareli. Watch the shareholder vote and closing conditions.
